assessments.kind: current reassessment of historical ROOT-ADM-F006; central alias/count decision
assessments.contract: TacticalGraphicsConfig::parse deserializes typed YAML then validates. For an otherwise valid document, if a scalar reaches its f32 visitor as `.nan`, the native typed parser yields NaN; comparisons of NaN with ordered finite values are false. The current root_occlusion check `<= 0 || > 1` therefore does not reject NaN despite its stated (0,1] constraint. The current maximum_push check tests only `< minimum_push`, so NaN is not rejected there even when radius and minimum_push pass their finite positive tests. The same defects occur in the 6533 config source and were recorded as ROOT-ADM-F006 by the earlier rig-independent root admission reviewer.
assessments.condition: This is a source-based conditional input chain and IEEE comparison reasoning, not a product run, emitted YAML fixture or proof a downstream renderer consumes those values. Assumes the document is otherwise valid, the concrete f32 Serde visitor is used, the source parser produces the relevant scalar event, and normal feature/option wiring shown is selected. No claim is made for arbitrary parser customizations or all constructors.
assessments.future_direction: In a later authorized repair consider rejecting nonfinite values at the typed configuration admission owner and preserving explicit intended bounds/order for each field; validate all construction paths and downstream consumers separately. No repair is made here.
relationships: Same source predicates and intended constraints as 774 ROOT-ADM-F006 in root/admission03/graphics-config-admission-022.json; 6533 and 95e support reads are independent current/historical work, not a new duplicate historical issue.

assessments.kind: current condition and unresolved policy, not additional issue
assessments.contract: The parser special spelling `.inf` yields positive infinity to a concrete f32 visitor, and the maximum_push comparison does not reject positive infinity against a finite minimum. The current positive() helper would reject nonfinite numbers but is not applied to maximum_push.
assessments.condition: Whether the maximum is required to be finite, what bounds are meaningful, and what any consumer does with infinity remain open. Do not infer a panic, a GPU effect, or a new issue merely from this acceptance.
assessments.future_direction: Establish an intended finite/range contract and trace the actual retained settings and grass consumers before choosing an admission representation or alias.

assessments.contract: With the documented default Options, angle conversions are false, and the reject_non_finite_typeless_float setting explicitly concerns deserialize_any, not concrete f32/f64. The typed float functions call parse_yaml12_float then visit_f32/visit_f64. Both shown non-angle branches recognize YAML nonfinite spellings after trim and case folding; ordinary numeric fallback rejects nonfinite parse results including overflow.
assessments.condition: The separate robotics angle-conversion branch may invoke a different helper if enabled and requested; it is not assessed. Typeless overflow behavior, full parser input normalization, scope handling and any downstream typed application policy are not fully audited. Literal normalization is library grammar, not itself a defect.
